objective: Compare Cloud Run and AWS ECS Fargate for hosting an Agentic AI runtime.

initial_tasks.description: Read official Cloud Run scaling and networking sources
Read official ECS Fargate scaling and networking sources

gap: Comparable cost cannot be calculated without region, CPU, memory, traffic, and task duration.

follow_up_task.description: List deployment inputs required for a comparable cost estimate

sources.title: Cloud Run autoscaling documentation
sources.content: Cloud Run automatically scales the number of instances based on incoming requests and configured concurrency. Minimum instances can reduce cold starts, while maximum instances can cap scale out.
sources.inspected_excerpt: Cloud Run automatically scales the number of instances based on incoming requests and configured concurrency.

sources.title: Amazon ECS Fargate documentation
sources.content: AWS Fargate is a serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine for running containers with Amazon ECS. Capacity and task configuration affect the resources billed.
sources.inspected_excerpt: AWS Fargate is a serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine for running containers with Amazon ECS.

report: Cloud Run scales instances based on incoming requests and configured concurrency [S1]. Fargate runs ECS containers with task resources that affect billing [S2]. A direct cost comparison needs deployment-specific inputs.
